questions.prompt: Name a punishment Allah sent upon a past nation in the Qur'an.

answers.explanation: The people of Nuh were drowned.
A screaming wind destroyed 'Ad for seven nights and eight days.
Thamud were seized by the blast (al-sayhah).
Rained upon the people of Lut.
The people of Shu'ayb were seized by the earthquake (al-rajfah).
Birds pelted Abraha's army with stones.

answers.canonical: The day of the shadowy cloud
answers.explanation: The people of al-Aykah (Shu'ayb) were punished by a cloud.
Saba's dam burst and their gardens were ruined.
Pharaoh's people were seized with years of famine and loss of fruits.

questions.prompt: Name a minor sign of the Day of Judgement mentioned in the Hadith.

notAccepted.message: That's one of the major signs. Try a minor one!

answers.explanation: Barefoot, poor shepherds competing in building tall buildings.
"Knowledge will be taken away and ignorance will spread."

answers.canonical: A slave woman giving birth to her mistress
variants: Slave woman gives birth to her mistress

answers.explanation: "When trust is lost, wait for the Hour."
Wealth will be so plentiful no one will accept charity.

answers.canonical: The Euphrates revealing a mountain of gold

answers.explanation: About thirty liars, each claiming to be a prophet.
The land of the Arabs will return to meadows and rivers.
People will treat zina, silk, alcohol and instruments as lawful.
Fifty women to one man looking after them.
A fire lighting up the necks of camels in Busra.
"The Hour will come when the Romans are the most numerous of people."
The first of six signs he listed.

questions.prompt: Name a people or ethnic group that is mostly Muslim.

answers.explanation: Across the Middle East and North Africa.
Most Punjabis in Pakistan are Muslim.

questions.prompt: Name something from the life of Abu Hurayrah (RA).

answers.explanation: "Father of the kitten" — he looked after a small cat.
He lived among the poor Companions in the mosque.
He came from Daws in Yemen, accepting Islam around Khaybar.
He spread his cloak and never forgot a hadith after.
He served one bowl of milk to all of Ahl al-Suffah before drinking.
The Prophet ﷺ prayed and his mother accepted Islam the same day.
Guarding the zakah food, a thief taught him Ayat al-Kursi — it was Shaytan.
His most accepted name was 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Sakhr.
He later served as governor of Madinah.

questions.prompt: Name an Islamic virtue by its Arabic name.

answers.explanation: Worshipping Allah as though you see Him; excellence.
Righteousness and goodness, especially to parents.

questions.prompt: Name an Arabic word for a time of day or night.

answers.explanation: The last part of the night before dawn.

bonus.prompt: Name something the Qur'an says people asked the Prophet ﷺ about ("They ask you about…").

answers.explanation: "They ask you about the Hour: when will it come?"
"Say: the spirit is of my Lord's command."
"In them is great sin and some benefit."
"They ask you what they should spend."
"Say: they are times for people and for Hajj."
"They ask you about fighting in the sacred month."
"Say: my Lord will scatter them as dust."
"They ask you what is made lawful for them."

answers.canonical: Kalalah (inheritance with no parent or child)
answers.explanation: "They ask your ruling — say: Allah gives you a ruling on kalalah."

bonus.prompt: Name something that makes ghusl (a full bath) obligatory.

notAccepted.message: That ghusl is recommended or differed over. Try one that is agreed obligatory!

answers.explanation: If one sees fluid on waking.
Release of fluid with desire, even without intercourse.

bonus.prompt: Name something from the story of the Year of the Elephant.

answers.explanation: The ruler of Yemen who marched on Makkah.
He brought an elephant to destroy the Ka'bah; it knelt and refused to move.
"He sent against them birds in flocks."
"Striking them with stones of baked clay."
He wanted to destroy it and turn the Arabs to his church in San'a.
He asked only for his camels back: "The House has a Lord who will protect it."

answers.canonical: The year the Prophet ﷺ was born
answers.explanation: He was born in the Year of the Elephant.
Al-Qullays, which Abraha built to rival the Ka'bah.
Abraha's men took two hundred of his camels.
Abraha ruled Yemen for the king of Abyssinia.
Where Abraha's guide died, near Ta'if.

bonus.prompt: Name a Companion whose name the Prophet ﷺ changed.

answers.explanation: "Zayd of the horses" became "Zayd of goodness".
Reported to have been 'Abd Shams before 'Abd al-Rahman.
'Ali wanted to call him Harb (war); the Prophet ﷺ named him al-Hasan.

bonus.prompt: Name one of the four best women of all time, according to the Hadith.

notAccepted.message: A great woman — but not one of the four named in this hadith. Try another!

answers.explanation: First wife of the Prophet ﷺ.

bonus.prompt: Name an Arabic word that comes from the root k-t-b (writing).

answers.explanation: A children's school for learning Qur'an and writing.
A contract by which a slave buys his freedom.
